output_list.criticism: The Primeo contract uses a timestamp as a dependency, which can be manipulated by miners. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for users who rely on the timestamp for their transactions.
The Primeo contract has a reentrancy vulnerability. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for users who call the withdraw function while the contract is in the middle of a transaction.
The Primeo contract has a reentrancy vulnerability. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for users who call the burn function while the contract is in the middle of a transaction.
